gaps.gap: report.py, the free DSH route and the subagent batches have unit tests; the scripts that call paid APIs are checked by hand on dev runs, and the probe exclusion from coverage by the final4 summary.

check_facts.py compares quotes up to a paragraph (500 characters) in «», „“, “” and up to 80 in straight marks; single quotes, longer quotes and quotes across a line break are not compared. It cannot tell a quotation from a term or an example inside a phrase, so only direct speech, quotes after a colon and a dash-opened dialogue line are errors; a lost quotation inside a phrase is only a check.

check_facts.py cannot tell a name from another name with the same stem (Мария/Марина, Марии/Марине) or a fleeting vowel beyond stem matching (Лев/Льва); a number rewritten as a word for a unit («24 часа» → «сутки») is reported as lost on purpose (numbers are carried as is); prose wrapped in ``` and a code block of mostly Cyrillic text are not compared as code. A month is found only as a noun in lower case or at a sentence start (adjectives «майские», «январский» are not months); a three-part dotted number with a two-digit month and year (3.11.12) is read as a date unless «версия», «релиз», «сборка» or v stands before it. Amounts swapped inside one sentence are found only when every item has its own clause between commas: not when the last two share one («Анна получила 30 000, Борис 50 000 и Вера 7 000», «Анна получила 30 000 и Борис 50 000», 91-95% of such swaps missed in generated lists) and not when a phrase between commas splits an item («Анна, врач, получила 30 000»). A difference in a comparison («на 20 000 меньше Бориса») is bound to the name in the comparison, so a rewrite that moves it into another person's part («Анна заработала 30 000 — на 20 000 меньше, чем Борис») gives a false swap error that 4.1.5 did not give (found by a reviewer; none on the 1446 old edits). A name the script does not recognise (a rare name or surname right after «руб.,», where the dot reads as a sentence end) can bind a number to its neighbour: 1 false alarm in 3000 generated rewrites with «руб.» (reordering «…Захар 450 руб. и Жанна 2 400 руб.»). A hedge word without a synonym (после, до, от) that stays at one mention of a number covers its loss at another; a hedge is not seen when a word other than «чем» stands between it and the number («минимум за 6»); in the edit the marks of bold and italic between a hedge and its number are ignored, in the source they hide the hedge, so «минимум **2 человека**» → «2 человека» loses it silently; «не свыше» is read as «свыше», and a synonym the script does not know («короче 3 дней» for «меньше 3 дней») counts as a lost hedge: the check then is silent, or reports a hedge that is in the text. Two people who share a first name or a surname are told apart by the other word; named in one sentence only by the shared word they are nobody's (silent), and a person who shares one word with two others (Анна Иванова, Анна Петрова, Борис Петров: Анна Петрова has no word of her own) cannot be bound. A sender after «от» is skipped as far as the capitalised words go: «от Бориса и Глеба» names Глеб as a receiver.
check_facts.py does not see lost conditions in words ("при включённой двухфакторной аутентификации"); the skill tells the agent to reread conditions.

The comparison emulates a skill run through the API with a read_file tool; installed runs in Claude Code and DSH are checked by hand on a few texts. final4 ran the executor as Claude Code subagents in batches (README), so its numbers compare participants with each other, not with earlier runs.
